chapter: Decca records, the Savoy and Moe Gale
title: The secret of Roll 'Em
summary: He says the secret of Kansas City Roll 'Em was the whole band, built from the rhythm section's chorus-by-chorus generator.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: What was the secret of Roll 'Em. Was it that the band as a whole or was it singers.

It was the band. That was the secret, the whole band, but you see, it started -- it all started from a generation from the rhythm section. The generator from the rhythm section as the rhythm section began to generate --
Did you begin it in the same way you were saying earlier with three or four choruses by the rhythm section.

That's the way we did it, and by the time we played four or five choruses, these cats, they getting mad, they wanted -- let us in there, let us in, so they threw up their hands, that brass hit then, the reeds fell in, well, they were ready to go. So it wasn't no stopping, I knew they wanted to go all the way.
